readerStylusOnlyOn: Stylus only: a resting hand will not draw.
readerStylusOnlyOff: Both finger and stylus can draw.
readerCopyNotAllowed: This document does not allow copying
readerNothingSelected: No text selected — long-press right on a word
readerEraserOn: Eraser on — swipe over the ink
readerEraserTooltip: Eraser — swipe over the wrong strokes
readerTapToPlaceSignature: Tap the page where the signature goes
readerCannotOverwriteAttachment: A library attachment cannot be overwritten — choose another name
readerNoLibraryOpen: No library is open in this app yet.
readerUnsavedNotIncluded: Unsaved annotations are not included. Save the PDF first if needed.
readerNoCollectionHint: into the library, not into any collection
readerCollectionNameHelper: Written to collections.json, synced to GitHub
readerPdfSavedAsImages: This PDF cannot be written directly; its pages are saved as images.
readerUnsavedStrokes: There are unsaved strokes. If you leave now, they will be lost.
readerTapToPlaceNote: Tap the page to place a note (tap again to cancel)
readerPlaceNote: Place a note on the page
readerDrawOnPage: Write or draw on the page
readerTapToPlaceText: Tap the page to place text (tap again to cancel)
readerFillText: Type text on the page — for filling in forms
readerKeepScreenOnActive: Screen stays on — tap to turn off
readerKeepScreenOn: Keep the screen on while reading
readerKeepScreenOnEnabled: The screen will stay on while reading
readerKeepScreenOnDisabled: The screen will turn off by itself again
readerAddToCollectionMenuHint: goes into the library and is synced
readerPrintMenuHint: to a printer, or save as PDF
readerToMarkdownHint: its text becomes an editable document
readerToNotebookHint: its pages become backgrounds you can edit
readerBlankPagesMenuHint: whiteboard at the end of the document
readerSaveMenuHintNew: choose a name and place; the original stays safe
readerStylusOnlyTooltip: Stylus only — touches from your hand do not draw
readerFingerAndStylusTooltip: Finger + stylus can draw — tap for stylus only
readerTapWhereNote: Tap a spot on the page to place the note.
readerFingerAndStylusShort: Finger + stylus — tap for stylus only
readerFitPage: Fit one page to the screen
readerAddScribbleSheet: Add a blank sheet to scribble on
readerClipboardEmpty: The clipboard holds no image or annotation
readerPasteImageUnsupported: Pasting images is not supported on this device yet — use "Choose an image file"
readerClipboardNoImage: The clipboard holds no image. In a browser: right-click the image → Copy image.
readerNotAnImage: The clipboard or file is not a readable image
readerPasteImageHint: e.g. "Copy image" in a browser — Ctrl+V
readerAnnotationCopied: Annotation copied — go to the target page, then Paste
readerAnnotationCut: Annotation cut — go to the target page, then Paste
readerDropOnPage: Drop it on a page to move it
readerAddedNotSaved: Added — not yet saved to the file
readerNoTableOfContents: This file has no table of contents.
readerSignatureHint: Write here, then tap the page to place it.
readerErrSourceMissing: The source file does not exist
readerErrPageCopy: The original page cannot be copied
readerErrBlankPage: The blank page cannot be created
readerNoteAnnotationsUnreadable: This note's annotations cannot be read: {error}
readerPageColorInverted: Page colour: {color} — marker colours are inverted too
readerAddToCollectionExplain: The file is copied into the library, given a Zotero item and committed — so it is synced to GitHub.
readerAddedButAnnotationsFailed: Added to the library, but copying its annotations failed: {error}
readerAddedWithAnnotations: Added to the library as {key} with {count, plural, =1{1 annotation} other{{count} annotations}} — readable in Zotero too once sent
readerNoTextLayer: This PDF has no text layer — probably a scan. Only its title came out.
readerPrintExplain: Some annotations are not part of the page yet, so they will not be printed. Save the PDF first if they need to be included.
readerBlankPagesExplain: The size of the first page. The original file is not touched — only a working copy changes, until you save it.
readerPagesAfter: {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}} after page {page}
readerPagesAtEnd: {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}} at the end of the document
readerBlankPagesAdded: {count} blank pages added at the end — save through the share menu
readerBlankPagesInserted: {count} blank pages inserted after page {page} — save through the share menu
readerUnsavedStandalone: The ink and annotations in {title} are not saved to a file yet. If you leave now, they will all be lost.
readerStatusOf: {count, plural, =1{1 annotation} other{{count} annotations}} · page {page} of {total}
readerCoachMark: To mark: tap "Mark", pick a colour, then swipe a finger over the text — it is coloured as soon as you lift your finger. To copy: leave "Mark" off, long-press the text, then choose Copy. For a note: tap the note icon, then tap the page.
readerMarkingBannerTouch: Swipe a finger over the text — lift it and it is marked {color}. Page scrolling and copying are off; tap Done to go back.
readerMarkingBannerMouse: Drag the mouse over the text — release the button and it is marked {color}. Page scrolling and copying are off; press Done to go back.
readerEraserBanner: Eraser: swipe over the wrong ink — every stroke it touches is removed whole.
readerPenBanner: Draw freely on the page with a finger or stylus.
readerPenPending: {count} strokes on page {page} — saved when you press Done.
readerImagePasted: Image pasted on page {page} — drag its corner to resize
readerPastedOnPage: Pasted on page {page} — drag to move it
readerNoSuchPage: There is no page {page} — this document has {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}}
readerOnePdfPages: One PDF with {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}}
readerFilesOnePerPage: {count, plural, =1{1 file} other{{count} files}}, one per page
readerExportExplain: Highlights, underlines and ink are drawn in. The original file is not touched.
readerExportPdfImages: Pages are stored as images inside the PDF, so the text cannot be searched or copied in that copy.
readerExportLarge: {count, plural, =1{1 page} other{{count} pages}} at this resolution will take a while and quite some storage.
readerNoAnnotationsYet:
No annotations yet.

Select text on the page, then choose Highlight or Highlight + comment.
readerPageMustBeBetween: The page must be between 1 and {count}
readerOverwriteOriginal:
{name} is the file that is open. Overwriting it loses the original, and the ink is merged into the pages.

Overwrite the original?
readerOverwriteExisting:
{name} already exists in this folder.

Replace it with the new one?
readerSaveAsExplain: The open file is not touched. After this, Save writes to this new file.
